page.title: System Map
page.description: Trace the system from business intent through screens, rules, code, data, deployment and evidence.

scopeGraph.title: Scope graph
scopeGraph.description: Drag a layer chip onto the canvas to add an element, drag between elements to connect them.
scopeGraph.empty: Drag a layer chip from the toolbar to add the first element.

canvas.paletteHint: Drag a layer onto the map:
canvas.readOnlyHint: This revision isn't a draft -- the map is read-only.
canvas.copyPasteHint: Select an element and press Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V to duplicate it, or paste (Ctrl+V) a flow the assistant wrote out to create it all at once. Click an element to edit it on the right panel.
canvas.pasteInvalid: Nothing valid found in the pasted text.

dataSpecPreview.title: DATA-SPEC preview
dataSpecPreview.help: Generated from this view's table/field elements -- a table "contains" its columns, and a relation directly between two tables becomes a foreign key. Draft only; review naming before it becomes a real migration.
dataSpecPreview.empty: No table elements modeled in this view yet -- drag a "data" layer chip and pick type "table" to start.

presets.loginScreenObjective: Authenticate the user before they can access the system.
presets.appShellObjective: Base layout every authenticated screen renders inside (header, navigation, content area).
presets.sidebarObjective: Primary navigation between the system's modules/screens.
